briefing.headline: US-China compute arms race intensifies as OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek-R2 near AGI thresholds

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs push model capabilities aggressively while regulatory scrutiny mounts. Funding remains robust but compute constraints are tightening globally.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with multi-agent reasoning gains. Anthropic and Google DeepMind followed with Claude 4 and Gemini 3 updates. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 while xAI and DeepSeek advanced their latest iterations.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines emphasize runtime monitoring.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC and Samsung ramp 2nm production for AI chips. Microsoft and Google announce $40B+ data center expansions in US and Europe amid power grid concerns.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory harmonization between US, EU and China slow the AGI timeline by more than 18 months?
